Simplified repro:

```pycon
>>> from poetry.inspection.lazy_wheel import metadata_from_wheel_url
>>> from requests import Session
>>> metadata_from_wheel_url("responses", "https://httpbin.org/redirect-to?url=https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/30/0b/bff1e6a5b646e6ff770deb6a292a96bd844ea13fb523ccbd9209fc4b90b8/responses-0.25.0-py3-none-any.whl", Session())
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File ".venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/poetry/inspection/lazy_wheel.py", line 609, in _extract_content_length
    file_length, tail = self._try_initial_chunk_request(initial_chunk_size)
                        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File ".venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/poetry/inspection/lazy_wheel.py", line 573, in _try_initial_chunk_request
    tail.raise_for_status()
  File ".venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/requests/models.py", line 1021, in raise_for_status
    raise HTTPError(http_error_msg, response=self)
requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 501 Server Error: Unsupported client range for url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/30/0b/bff1e6a5b646e6ff770deb6a292a96bd844ea13fb523ccbd9209fc4b90b8/responses-0.25.0-py3-none-any.whl

During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
  File ".venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/poetry/inspection/lazy_wheel.py", line 77, in metadata_from_wheel_url
    with LazyWheelOverHTTP(url, session) as lazy_file:
  File ".venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/poetry/inspection/lazy_wheel.py", line 289, in __enter__
    self._setup_content()
  File ".venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/poetry/inspection/lazy_wheel.py", line 357, in _setup_content
    self._length = self._fetch_content_length()
                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File ".venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/poetry/inspection/lazy_wheel.py", line 508, in _fetch_content_length
    ret_length, tail = self._extract_content_length(initial_chunk_size)
                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File ".venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/poetry/inspection/lazy_wheel.py", line 638, in _extract_content_length
    return self._content_length_from_head(), None
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File ".venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/poetry/inspection/lazy_wheel.py", line 388, in _content_length_from_head
    assert head.status_code == codes.ok
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AssertionError
```
perhaps just `allow_redirects=True` on the HEAD request
